test_framework: None effective. `npm run test` maps to `heft test --clean` but there is NO Jest/vitest config in /config, so there are no runnable unit tests. Verify via the build/lint gate instead.

test_command: npm run build  (no real unit tests; the build is the verification gate). `npm run build:ship` for a production-style build.

snapshot_or_generated_files: Heft build emits to lib/ and dist/ and sharepoint/solution/*.sppkg; these are build outputs, not checked-in snapshots. Nothing needs to be regenerated-and-committed for this task.
environment_constraints: The worktree at d:\E-Sign\E-sign-B-Simple\.worktrees\batch-esign has no node_modules of its own; run `npm install` there before building (the parent repo's node_modules cannot satisfy the worktree tsconfig 'extends'). Never provision SharePoint columns from code. Never add email-sending code (all email is Power Automate). The Power Automate flow triggers on item-created in LIST_PROCESS, so adding one Approvals Process item per document fires per-document initiate emails automatically.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code style: PnPjs via getSP(context, webUrl?), constants from src/common/constants.ts, Fluent UI dialogs (Dialog.alert / @fluentui/react Dialog), OData single-quote escaping with .replace(/'/g, "''"). Do NOT modify COMMAND_1/2/3 behavior or the single-document initiate/approve flows. Commit locally on branch feature/batch-esign-finance; never push.
key_patterns: getSP(context, baseUrl?) returns SPFI (src/common/pnpjsConfig.ts). Cross-site reads pass a base URL like `${TENANT_DOMAIN}/${SITE_REDIRECT}` (DMS) or `${TENANT_DOMAIN}/${SITES_ESIGN}` (eSign). Task cancellation pattern: query LIST_TASKS where `ProcessID/Id eq <id> and Status eq 'Pending'`, update each to Status='Canceled' with Comments (see _cancelPendingTasks in InitiateEsignCommandSet.ts and _cancelProcess in InitiateEsignForm.tsx). System-cancel convention: set process Notes to `System Canceled: <reason>` (prefix constant SYSTEM_CANCEL_PREFIX in EsignDataService.ts) so the approval form's canceled-dialog detection keeps working. Command visibility lives in _updateCommandVisibility(); COMMAND_1 shows when isSelectedRowCount===1 and a .pdf is selected in an Active-Sites-whitelisted location.
